description: Every gallery image for a product with high-resolution URLs. Each image lists only renditions that actually exist, largest first — modern photography is 2048x2048 WebP at the 'original' size — plus the metal tone, band width, and finish the photo shows, and descriptive alt text. Identify the product by exactly one of slug, style_code, or url. Pass metal to order the gallery for that metal: the photo that best shows it comes first, and matches_selected_metal says which photos show it.

metal_tone.description: Optionally return only photos showing this metal tone

name: get_product_images

matches_selected_metal.description: Whether the photo shows the selected variant's metal tone; absent when unknown
